Ta có: $\displaystyle \int_1^3 \frac{x+2}{x} dx = \int_1^3 \left( 1 + \frac{2}{x} \right) dx = (x + 2\ln|x|) \Big|_1^3 = 3 + 2\ln 3 - 1 = 2 + 2\ln 3$.\\
		Nên $a=2, b=2, c=3 \Rightarrow S = a+b+c = 7$.

Theo giả thiết $\displaystyle F(x) = \int f(x)\,dx = \int (2^x + x + 1)\,dx = \frac{2^x}{\ln 2} + \frac{x^2}{2} + x + C$.\\
		Mặt khác $\displaystyle F(0) = 1 \Rightarrow \frac{2^0}{\ln 2} + C = 1 \Rightarrow C = 1 - \frac{1}{\ln 2}$.\\
		Khi đó $\displaystyle |F(-1)| = \left| \frac{2^{-1}}{\ln 2} + \frac{1}{2} - 1 + 1 - \frac{1}{\ln 2} \right| = \left| \frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{2\ln 2} \right| \approx 0,22$.
